matched_starts.runner:
"""Replay representative kind-4 passes at equivalent startup phases."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

OUTPUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
WORKTREE = OUTPUT.parent / "worktree"
ROOT = OUTPUT.parents[2]
INCLUDE = ROOT / ".deps/rtl/oss-cad-suite/share/verilator/include"
ICO_ONLY = "--ico" in sys.argv[1:]
DRIVER = OUTPUT / "isolated-ico.cpp" if ICO_ONLY else OUTPUT.parent / "isolated.cpp"
OBJECT_NAMES = (
    "setup", "renderer", "demo", "hw_protocol", "sdram_model",
    "verilated", "verilated_dpi", "verilated_vcd_c", "verilated_threads",
)


def measure(label, model_dir):
    model = WORKTREE / "build" / model_dir
    obj = model / "obj"
    executable = OUTPUT / (f"{label}-isolated-ico.exe" if ICO_ONLY else f"{label}-isolated.exe")
    objects = [obj / f"{name}.o" for name in OBJECT_NAMES]
    objects.append(obj / "Vnano_gpu_core__ALL.a")
    flags = [
        "-std=c++17", "-O2", "-pthread", "-DVL_TIME_CONTEXT=1",
        "-DNANO_GPU_ORACLE_ONLY=1", "-DNANO_GPU_BOARD_PROFILE=1",
        "-DVM_TRACE=1", "-DVM_TRACE_VCD=1", "-DVM_TRACE_FST=0",
    ]
    includes = [obj, INCLUDE, INCLUDE / "vltstd", WORKTREE / "reference/include", WORKTREE / "reference/rtl"]
    subprocess.run(
        ["g++", *flags, *(f"-I{path}" for path in includes),
         str(DRIVER), *map(str, objects), "-o", str(executable)], check=True,
    )
    cases = []
    for scene in (("ico-flat",) if ICO_ONLY else ("vertex0", "vertex1", "closeup")):
        for offset in (0, 12345, 700000):
            stats = OUTPUT / f"{label}-{scene}-{offset}.json"
            subprocess.run([str(executable), scene, str(offset), str(stats)], check=True)
            cases.append(json.loads(stats.read_text()))
    return {
        "build": json.loads((model / "build-report.json").read_text()),
        "executable_sha256": hashlib.sha256(executable.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "cases": cases,
    }


before = measure("before", "pass2-before-model")
after = measure("after", "tang20k-core-sim")
paired = []
for old, new in zip(before["cases"], after["cases"], strict=True):
    for key in ("case", "idle_cycles", "initial_core_cycle", "initial_video_x",
                "initial_video_y", "initial_sdram_refreshes"):
        assert old[key] == new[key], (key, old, new)
    assert old["oracle_checked"] and new["oracle_checked"]
    assert old["scanout_underflows"] == new["scanout_underflows"] == 0
    paired.append({
        "case": old["case"], "idle_cycles": old["idle_cycles"],
        "before": old["core_cycles"], "after": new["core_cycles"],
    })
report = {"before": before, "after": after, "paired": paired,
          "driver_sha256": hashlib.sha256(DRIVER.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(OUTPUT / ("matched-ico.json" if ICO_ONLY else "matched.json")).write_text(
    json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
print(json.dumps(paired, indent=2))
